scope: Route 5, Route 6, and Route 7 quality pass
rules: Every audited city must keep all five image slots: hero, history, present, route, and street.
Hero and history slots must prove the city's core story, not generic atmosphere.
Route slots must explain why the city belongs in this route sequence.
Briefed assets are allowed only when the production note clearly names the replacement target.
Generic source homepages are not enough for audited cities; use a specific official or reference page when possible.

daejeon.reason: Daejeon now needs stronger proof than a generic corridor image because Route 8 depends on Sungsimdang, Yuseong, science-city identity, Daejeon Station, and the first southbound split.
daejeon.nextAction: Find or produce separate bakery-street, Yuseong recovery, science-city, station, and route-junction visuals before marking all slots final.
